subject.title: [Bug]: Block streaming can drop paragraph separators across streamed updates

question: Should the canonical fix preserve paragraph boundaries by carrying separators in-band on emitted chunks, by carrying explicit boundary metadata, or by another shared pipeline contract?
rationale: The bug is source-backed and the fix belongs in the shared streaming boundary, but two open PRs choose similar text-level repairs and maintainers should confirm the permanent boundary contract before one lands.

options.title: Consolidate on full boundary preservation
options.body: Choose one PR or replacement that preserves paragraph separators across flush boundaries and covers doubled-separator and maxChars edge cases before merge.

options.title: Accept a common-case text repair
options.body: Land one candidate for ordinary paragraph splits now and track maxChars or explicit-boundary metadata as a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Pause both candidate PRs
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking for a fresh design if maintainers do not want separator-carrying chunks as the pipeline contract.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on full boundary preservation
recommendation.body: Choose one PR or replacement that preserves paragraph separators across flush boundaries and covers doubled-separator and maxChars edge cases before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-file blame and recent adjacent chunking/coalescer history make this the best available routing owner for the shared boundary contract choice.
